dict.string: Captain’s Log connects to a recorder you approve and privately transfers recordings to this Mac.
Captain’s Log adds, updates, and removes reversible calendar events inferred by your private on-device automations.
Captain’s Log adds and removes reminders inferred by your private on-device automations, and lets you correct or undo them.
Captain’s Log creates and removes reversible items in Notes, Mail, and Contacts when one of your private on-device automations requests it.
